title: Sisters Jackie and Lynn, Backyard Lawn Plaid - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming summer portrait of two young sisters, annotated as 'Jackie and Lynn' on the top margin of the print, standing together on a grassy lawn. The younger girl in front wears a ruffled white collared blouse, a high-waisted pleated plaid skirt, and laced shoes, while her older sister stands right behind her in a coordinating white top with her hair styled in soft curls and a bow. In the background, a leafy shrub stands beside a wooden telephone pole against a clear sky, exemplifying everyday postwar domestic life in suburban America.
